title: O'Neil-type inequalities in Morrey spaces on the set T^n
summary: This paper studies O'Neil-type convolution inequalities in local and generalized Morrey spaces on the n-dimensional torus. We extend classical Minkowski and Young inequalities to the Morrey setting and obtain boundedness results for convolution operators. The main result is a generalization of O'Neil's inequality from Lorentz spaces to Morrey-type spaces via dyadic decompositions. We derive norm estimates for convolution operators between Morrey spaces with different parameters and characterize the admissible range of exponents ensuring boundedness.
